extractedItems.ruleName: Ball at rest moved by an outside influence
extractedItems.group: Ball at rest moved by an outside influence
extractedItems.title: What to do if your ball is moved by an animal
extractedItems.question: A dog runs onto the course and moves your ball from where it was resting. What should you do?

choices.text: Play the ball from its new position
Put the ball back as close as possible to its original spot, no penalty
Take a penalty stroke and drop the ball
Move to the next hole

extractedItems.explanation: You must put your ball back as close as possible to its original position. There is no penalty when an outside influence moves your ball.
extractedItems.imagePrompt: A dog is running away with a golf ball while a teenage girl golfer prepares to put the ball back on the fairway.
extractedItems.imageAlt: A dog moves a girl's golf ball and she gets ready to put it back.

extractedItems.title: What counts as a lost ball?
extractedItems.question: You hit your ball into the trees and spend 4 minutes looking for it but can't find it. What is the correct procedure?

choices.text: Take a drop near the spot where the ball was lost with no penalty
Continue searching for as long as needed
Return to where you last played, take a drop within one club-length, and add one penalty stroke
Play another ball from a different spot

extractedItems.explanation: If you cannot find your ball within 3 minutes, it's lost. You must return to where you last played, take a drop within one club-length, and take a one-stroke penalty.
extractedItems.imagePrompt: A teenage boy golfer looks for his ball in the rough for a long time and walks back to replay his last shot.
extractedItems.imageAlt: A boy golfer searching for a lost ball in the trees, returning to replay his shot.

extractedItems.title: What happens if you accidentally hit the ball twice in one swing?
extractedItems.question: During a tricky chip, your club accidentally strikes the ball twice in a single swing. How many strokes do you count and is there a penalty?

choices.text: Count two strokes and add a penalty stroke
Count one stroke and no penalty
Count one stroke and add a penalty stroke
Ignore the shot completely

extractedItems.explanation: A double hit counts as only one stroke with no penalty.
extractedItems.imagePrompt: A teenage girl accidentally double-hits the ball during a chip shot on the fairway.
extractedItems.imageAlt: A girl golfer chips the ball and accidentally makes a double hit.
